# P31.16 — Re-materialize, re-export, republish (P31)

- **Semantic id:** `SURFACE.3` · **Phase:** 31 · **Kind:** ticket · **Tag:** p31-followups · **Wave:** B (surface tail)
- **base_branch:** `devin/p31-15-vector-tiles-and-compression` · **Depends on:** P31.2, P31.6–P31.9, P31.11–P31.15
- **Run:** `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/P31.16__rematerialize-reexport-republish.md live_verification=true`
- **Gate status:** **HG-11** (design §6 Q10). The first public relationship edges and accountability links (org ↔ org,
  vendor ↔ agency) and negative-space coverage change what the site asserts. The ticket pauses after the re-export
  with a **published-diff summary** and publishes only on the operator's sign-off. Unsigned: complete with the gate
  pending (RETURN PASS); the export stays in the restricted bucket.

## Goal
Publish the deepened graph, with the materialized state rebuilt in order from one settled spine, one read-only
snapshot export, licence-separated publication, and every surface-visible deferral half verified live.

## Load (cite; do not copy)
- `docs/build/runs/P30.3.md` (the recipe) + `docs/build/reports/LAUNCH_RECORD_2026-09-24.md` (the baseline to diff
  against). ADR-090/092/101/103/106/107, ADR-102 (temporary scale-up pattern). `DEFERRALS.md`: the surface halves noted
  by P31.2 (D-P30.3-1), P31.14 (D-P30.3-3), P31.15 (D-P30.3-2), and the edge/accountability appearance of D-P30.2-2.
- Code/ops: `ops/gcp/materialize.sh` (resolution → camera-sites → edges → contradictions → coverage → accountability →
  detect), `ops/gcp/export.sh`, `ops/src/ops/publish.py` (`assert_separated`, `assert_public_clean`,
  `assert_site_matches_partition`), `probe-hosted`.

## In scope — deliverables
1. **Measure and plan.** Read-only spine shape and an ETA for the full materializer sequence and the export. If the
   ETA needs it, scale `sig-pg` up temporarily (ADR-102 pattern, recorded). If a tier restart happens, **verify
   that `sig-api` rides through it with no recycle** (the second production proof of D-P30.4-1). If it does not,
   recycle on the current digest per ADR-107 §5 and reopen D-P30.4-1. If no scale-up is needed, say that the
   restart proof rests on P31.1's hosted backend-kill test alone.
2. **Re-materialize in order**, each step as a Cloud Run job, each re-run for +0, with counts read back.
3. **National re-export** from one `REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY` snapshot (`export.sh`, SHA-tagged image). Record the watermark.
4. **Published-diff summary** against the launch record: new surfaces, edge and link counts with examples, the
   negative-space scale, the resolved-site metric change, and freshness. **HG-11 pause.**
5. **Publish (on sign-off)** through the fail-closed publish path. Build `web/dist` in export mode. Restricted stays
   private. **Roll `sig-web`** (P31.15's repo-owned nginx compression config and the new tiles) **by digest**,
   recording the previous digest for rollback. `sig-web` must keep serving 200 throughout. Then `probe-hosted` plus both origins verified showing the new data. Scale `sig-pg` back down (ADR-107 tier)
   if it was scaled up, and verify `sig-api` again.
6. **Record:** a dated republish record under `docs/build/reports/`. Flip the surface halves (D-P30.3-1/-2/-3, and
   D-P30.2-2's public appearance) to DONE with live evidence.

## Out of scope
- New materializer logic (every earlier ticket owns its own). Merging/tagging `main`. Any gate other than HG-11.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every materializer re-run in order, each +0 on repeat, counts recorded *(live)*.
- [ ] One read-only snapshot export with a recorded watermark; compartments separated; restricted private *(live)*.
- [ ] HG-11 sign-off recorded before publishing; `probe-hosted` green; new surfaces verified on `surveillancegraph.org` and run.app *(live)*.
- [ ] The `sig-api` restart behaviour is verified (no recycle needed), or D-P30.4-1 is reopened honestly; the tier is back at ADR-107 steady state.
- [ ] The republish record is committed; the surface-half deferrals are flipped with evidence.

## Cross-cutting invariants
Cited from `docs/tickets/00_MANIFEST.md` and design §5: compartment separation (ODbL/CC-BY-SA per ADR-106; downloads
single-licence); the PROVISIONAL disclosure stays until D-R6.1-EVAL closes; never a total; SHA-tagged images, never
`:latest`; in-container literal DSN; after any DB restart `sig-api` is verified (and recycled only on its current
digest); re-run +0; no merge/tag/push-main.
